description: fars_cleaner is a Python package for obtaining and preparing United States Fatality Analysis Reporting System records. It can fetch selected years of the federal crash-fatality release, unpack them into a local cache and return Pandas tables with coded fields converted to readable categories. This helps researchers compare records despite changes to variable names and codes across yearly files. Spatial coverage is the United States and the time span follows the selected FARS releases, not observations created by the package. The public GitHub repository and installation instructions show BSD-3-Clause source access. Prepared crash records can help examine road-safety interventions, calibrate fatality risk in network simulations or compare exposure near transport assets. The package does not itself supply a new crash survey or correct errors in federal reporting. Researchers still need to inspect yearly coding differences and the suitability of a fatal-only sample for their simulation. Its fetcher downloads source data during actual use; this review did not run it or download those files. No existing catalogue or first-review draft covers this named Python package. No directly related catalogue record was established.
